disposition: Useful broader comparison with material corrections. Northwest remains preferred for low-volume initial setup; Texas Virtual Office LLC is a stronger alternative than the report describes.

primary_checks.observed: Afterplace is offered for $6.99. Developer is Evan Kice LLC at 5900 Balcones Dr Ste 100, Austin. FMCSA lists Northwest at the same street/suite.
primary_checks.limit: Demonstrates this public Texas address outcome; the developer's provider, purchased plan and private verification history remain unknown. Does not identify the future assigned Northwest suite.
primary_checks.retrieval: Locale-parameter URL failed; canonical Play URL opened successfully. Release description says December 2022, contrary to the report's general statement that release dates could not be found.

primary_checks.observed: $15/month office plan explicitly advertises a month-to-month lease, unlimited content scans and no per-document fees. Registered agent $25/year. $435 formation includes state fee and a registered-agent year.
primary_checks.calculation: $435 + 12*$15 = $615 base first year with their formation service; $25 + 12*$15 = $205 base renewal. Compared with Northwest quote: $177 more first year, $19 less per renewal year.
primary_checks.limit: Advertised inclusions, not a checked checkout or specimen contract. Exact address, additional charges and provider-specific Google/D&B acceptance unresolved.
primary_checks.report_correction: Do not retain the claims that lease, scan allowance and first-year registered agent were unverified. Northwest is not the cheapest recurring lease-bearing route.

primary_checks.observed: The Farm lists $218/month utility-bill tier with six-month commitment and five shared-office days; $350/month lease/utility tier with twelve-month commitment and inspection/call support. The page expressly disclaims platform approval guarantees.
primary_checks.limit: Vendor-advertised services and documents, not measured Google/D&B success. No reason established to buy these now. Exact location rights and terms need confirmation for any later use.

primary_checks.observed: October 2026 terms say purchases generally non-refundable after 90 days, and state fees never refundable.
primary_checks.limit: This does not promise an unconditional refund before 90 days. Do not describe formation/address purchase as a risk-free verification trial.

primary_checks.observed: Shared Corporate Tools resources appear in provider page output.
primary_checks.limit: Shared software, analytics, chat or premises do not independently establish common legal ownership, identical contract fulfillment or identical verification outcomes. Report introduction is more categorical than its own limitations.

primary_checks.observed: D&B technology partner describes authenticated images and geolocation in business verification.
primary_checks.limit: Partner evidence of a verification mechanism; not proof all developers receive a photo check or that Northwest addresses categorically fail. Flagged-application abandonment is not a general rejection rate.

primary_checks.observed: Organization identity and address come from the linked payments profile, with D-U-N-S matching and public display requirements.
primary_checks.limit: No provider-specific acceptance or rejection established. D&B success alone is not a guaranteed Google approval.

Exact common ownership asserted from shared software/premises.

Davinci, Regus, BusinessAnywhere and Office Evolution package specifics.
